business: Moduo Team: an all-in-one workspace with chat for small agencies and studios
target: Owners and leads of agencies or studios with 3 to 5 people doing client work (design, dev, marketing, content)
where: Online; mostly US, UK and EU

behaviours.name: ClickUp or Asana refugee
behaviours.how: Found their last tool overwhelming and wants something simpler.

behaviours.name: Basecamp flat-pricer
behaviours.how: Values flat pricing so clients and contractors cost nothing extra.

behaviours.name: Trello plus Slack
behaviours.how: Runs projects on Trello boards and talks in Slack.

behaviours.name: Time-tracking first
behaviours.how: Chooses tools by how well they track billable hours per client.

behaviours.name: Owner decides alone
behaviours.how: Picks tools quickly, but switches only if the team won't revolt.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Needs G2 or Capterra reviews and a stable vendor before moving the team.

objections: We need time tracking per client, and this doesn't do it
Clients and contractors need access without paying for a seat
Moving the whole team off Slack and Trello is a big ask
No way to show a client project status without inviting them
Basecamp is $59 flat for unlimited people; per seat adds up
A new tool from a two-person startup is a risk for client work
We need a 'waiting on client' or 'in review' state
habits: you run a Monday stand-up mainly to find out who's on what
two freelancers work with you on and off
you estimate projects in a spreadsheet and overrun half of them
clients email you for status updates every week
_notes: Draws on .design/tasks-dogfood/research-2026-10/segments.md 1c (Hubstaff 53% time-tracking pain, Monday 3-seat minimum, Basecamp $59 flat). Time-per-client, waiting/review states and client status links are known gaps (research section 6), so they appear as objections, not features. Shares and incomes are guesses. Founders' review 2026-10-19: kept as written.
